idea: Co-op chaotic firefighters on Roblox: alarm, burning town block, hose, axe, rescues, Blame awards.

issues.problem: The report has no `flareups` counter, so no flare-up was ever confirmed in the 63 s playtest (about 7 ticks). Nothing says whether RoundState was never "Active", RandomFlammable returned nil, or Ignite returned false. `_tick` returns silently on all of these paths, and the pcall wrappers around RandomFlammable and Ignite swallow errors. A dead service looks the same as an idle one.
issues.fix_hint: Add rate-limited diagnostics in `_tick`. For example, `warn` once (guarded by a flag) when MapService or FireService is nil, when the RandomFlammable pcall fails or returns nil, and when the Ignite pcall errors. Print the error message in each case. Also log a `[FlareUpService] ignited <part:GetFullName()>` line on success so the Studio playtest console shows whether the loop ran.

issues.problem: A single Ignite call on one random part can return false (already burning, not flammable, or out of range). With an 8 s interval and one attempt per tick, a short round can produce zero counted flare-ups. This makes the acceptance criterion fragile.
issues.fix_hint: Within one tick, retry picking a part up to about 5 times until Ignite returns true, then count once and stop. Keep the 8 s interval between ticks.

issues.problem: `getTelemetry()` runs `require` and may block up to 5 s in `WaitForChild` on every successful ignition. If ForgeTelemetry is missing, that stalls the loop each time and returns nil silently.
issues.fix_hint: Resolve and cache the telemetry module once in `Start` (or lazily, storing it in `self._telemetry`). Reuse the cached module in `_tick`, and `warn` once if it cannot be loaded.

issues.problem: The loop is `while true` with no stop condition, and `Start` never stores the thread. This is minor, but the loop cannot be cancelled and keeps polling in the lobby.
issues.fix_hint: Store the `task.spawn` thread in `self._thread`. Skip the work cheaply when RoundState is not Active. This already happens, so just keep the check as the first line of `_tick`.

iterations.summary: The server booted cleanly with no errors and no [Boot] warnings, and FlareUpService is a correct, spec-shaped module with a safe loop. But the `flareups` counter is absent from the report, so the first acceptance criterion was not demonstrated. The playtest never produced an Active round, or every Ignite attempt failed silently. The only warning is the CityBuilder part budget (31108 > 30000), which belongs to a file not provided here.

issues.problem: The `flareups` counter is absent and no `[FlareUpService]` log lines appear (no 'ignited', no warnings). The loop only acts while RoundState == "Active", and the playtest never got there, so flare-ups were never exercised and the acceptance criterion cannot be confirmed. Nothing in the logs shows whether the round never started or whether the picks failed.
issues.fix_hint: Keep the logic. Add a one-time print the first time `_tick` sees RoundState == "Active" (for example 'round active, MissionId=...'). Also warnOnce when RandomFlammable returns nil, which is already partly done. Confirm that `Names.Attr.RoundState` and `Names.Attr.MissionId` resolve to the attribute names the round service sets, and that "Active" is the exact value it uses.

issues.problem: Start() calls task.spawn twice: one extra call only preloads telemetry (with a 5 s WaitForChild), then the loop starts. The spec says Start starts ONE task.spawn loop.
issues.fix_hint: Remove the preload `task.spawn(function() loadTelemetry(self) end)` from Start. `_tick` already loads telemetry lazily on the first successful ignite. Alternatively, call loadTelemetry(self) at the top of the single loop thread before the first wait.

issues.problem: The attempt loop runs up to 5 RandomFlammable/Ignite tries back to back with no yield. After the first failure the warnings are suppressed by warnOnce, and if all 5 fail nothing is logged. Flare-ups can silently stop for the whole round.
issues.fix_hint: After the attempt loop finishes with no ignition, call warnOnce(self, 'noIgnite', 'no ignition after ' .. MAX_ATTEMPTS .. ' attempts'). Optionally add a `task.wait()` between attempts so one tick cannot hog the frame.

iterations.summary: The game boots cleanly with no runtime errors, and the map, lobby, traffic and truck services all start. No round reached Active during the 62.9 s playtest, so the `flareups` counter is missing and the main acceptance criterion is unverified. FlareUpService follows the spec and is defensive, but it starts two task.spawn calls where the spec asks for one. The report also carries a `[CityBuilder] 31108 parts > budget 30000` warning, which breaks the 'no warnings' criterion.
